script.problem: The quote "Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. 'I am willing,' He said. 'Be clean!'" isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: “Jesus is willing” in response to whatever the reader cannot fix may imply that He will resolve every problem as requested. The passage shows His willingness to cleanse this man, not a promise to grant every such request.
